fields.reason: Trial 3 shows frozen MobileNet features with logistic C10 is strongest so far at 0.8375 search accuracy, but that route is exhausted and not among available candidates. fields.review: Evidence is limited to primary-split trials. Trial 1 raw-pixel logistic overfit strongly; trial 2 gradient-histogram logistic reached 0.4; trial 3 frozen-feature logistic reached 0.8375. Available candidates are all raw-pixel baselines, so this choice is a coverage-oriented probe rather than a predicted improvement over trial 3.
